info.title: Attome XRM API
info.description: The Attome XRM platform's HTTP API. Entity record shapes under `/api/v1/{entity}` are resolved from each deployment's runtime metadata (D-003) and therefore cannot be enumerated statically — those operations document the generic envelope only. Fetch `GET /api/v1/schema/{logicalname}` for a live entity's fields.

get.summary: A booking from its manage link
get.description: The booking a manage link names.

200.description: The booking

404.description: Altered or expired link

post.description: Cancels the booking and its meeting.

200.description: Cancelled

404.description: Altered or expired link

409.description: Already cancelled or started

200.description: Moved

404.description: Altered or expired link

409.description: The time is not free, or the booking is cancelled or started

422.description: Not a time the page offers

parameters.description: From (UTC); not before the page's notice.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: To (UTC); not past the page's horizon, at most 31 days after `from`.

200.description: The page and its free times

404.description: No such page

201.description: Booked; the confirmation email has the manage link

get.description:
The account's contacts (or its group's) that the caller may read, by
who they report to; a contact whose manager is missing or unreadable is
listed as unplaced. Branches deeper than three levels are collapsed to a
count unless named in `expand`; at most 500 contacts a call, the rest
through `cursor`.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The whole group: every account sharing the top of the parent chain.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated contact ids whose collapsed branches to open.

200.description: The chart

403.description: Caller may not read contacts

404.description: No such account the caller may read

post.description:
Queues a PDF of the account's people from the built-in "Account org
chart" document template, rendered with what the caller may read, and
answers the render's id.

404.description: No such account the caller may read, or no org chart template

422.description: A format other than pdf

post.summary: Proposes reports-to links for an account.
post.description:
Queues a job that writes open org chart drafts for the account's people
the caller may read, from their titles and departments. Nothing changes a
contact until a person accepts a draft.

404.description: No such account the caller may read

post.description:
Records a call attempt on a member the caller claimed: a final outcome (connected, wrong number, not
interested) ends it, anything else puts it back after the list's retry wait, and the list's outcome
rules run after commit. Audited.

201.description: The attempt is saved and the list's outcome rules are queued

403.description: The member is not claimed by the caller

404.description: No such member

422.description: Unknown outcome

post.summary: Skips a claimed call list member.
post.description:
The member the caller claimed leaves the queue as skipped, with the
reason given; the dialer's next claim moves on to the next member. Only
the rep who claimed it may skip it.

200.description: The member is skipped

403.description: The member is not claimed by the caller

404.description: No such member

422.description: The reason is empty or too long

post.description:
Adds members as the caller sees them: from the list's saved view, from the caller's phone calls due
today, or from records named by hand, each checked for read access. Audited.

200.description: Members added from the list's source

403.description: Caller lacks call_list.update, or may not read a named record

404.description: No such list, saved query or record

409.description: The list is being filled by another request

422.description: The list has no usable source

post.description:
Takes the list's next pending member for the caller, so two callers never get the same one; a
member marked do-not-call, or without sales-call consent where that is required, is skipped.
Audited.

200.description: The next callable member, or null when none is left; members passed over are listed with their reasons

403.description: Caller lacks call_list.call, or the list is someone else's shared list and the caller lacks call_list.share

404.description: No such call list

post.description:
Starts the call through the phone system: the agent's own phone rings, then the customer's, with the
caller id chosen for the customer's country, and the call is logged on the record. Audited.

200.description: Ringing the caller's phone; the call is logged

403.description: Caller lacks call_list.call or may not log calls on the record

404.description: No such call list, or no voice system

422.description: Not an E.164 number, no agent number set, or the provider refused

503.description: The phone system did not answer in time

post.description: Plays a recorded voicemail into the current call, on a call list that allows it. Audited.

204.description: The message is playing; the call hangs up after it

403.description: Caller lacks call_list.call

404.description: No such call list, or not the caller's call

422.description: Voicemail drop is off for this list, or not an https recording

503.description: The phone system did not answer in time

Puts the competitor on the deal as suspected unless it is there already, and marks the mention
confirmed. Needs update rights on the deal and the mention's `If-Match` row version. Audited.

404.description: No such mention

409.description: Stale row_version, or already decided

422.description: If-Match missing or malformed

Marks the proposed mention rejected. Needs update rights on the deal and the mention's `If-Match`
row version. Audited.

200.description: The mention is rejected

409.description: Stale row_version, or already decided

422.description: If-Match missing or malformed

200.description: The competitor's fields the caller may read, and its battle card article when set and readable

404.description: No such competitor, or competitors are not installed

get.description:
The competitor's record against us on the deals the caller may read: outcomes, the mentions and the
review reasons.

post.summary: Records that a contact left their company.
post.description:
Marks the contact a former employee as of `left_on` (keeping the record
and its history) and lists the contacts who reported to them, for a new
manager. With `new_account_id`, also creates the person's contact at
that account (duplicate rules apply) and links the two with a `moved_to`
relationship. Send the contact's `row_version` in `If-Match`.

200.description: Recorded; the reports to reassign are listed

403.description: Caller may not update the contact

404.description: No such contact or account the caller may read

409.description: The contact changed since it was read, or the new contact looks like a duplicate

422.description: A missing If-Match or an invalid field

put.summary: Sets who a contact reports to.
put.description:
Sets or clears the contact's solid or dotted reporting line. The manager
must work at the contact's account or at an account in its group, and the
line may not form a loop. Send the contact's `row_version` in `If-Match`.
The answer names the previous manager, so setting it back undoes the
change.

200.description: The line is set

403.description: Caller may not update the contact

404.description: No such contact or manager the caller may read

409.description: The contact changed since it was read

422.description: Unrelated account, a loop, or a missing If-Match

Checks the chosen options against the bundle's option groups (minimum

ErrorDetails.description:
`ErrorResponse.details`: its shape depends on the `error` code —
a list of [`FieldError`] on `validation_error`, [`RuleViolationDetails`] on
`rule_violation`, [`FieldLockedDetails`] on `field_locked` and
`field_locked_required` (D-789).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope. `error` is a stable machine-readable code; `message` is human-readable and never contains internal detail.

current_state.description:
Present on a version conflict: the server's current row for the
fields the caller touched, as a JSON object. The owning engine filters
sensitive columns out before building it (BTY-16c's precondition), so
this is a deliberate filtered projection — never a raw row dump.

current_version.description:
Present on a version conflict: the `row_version` the server currently
holds, so a caller can re-read and retry instead of guessing what the
winner wrote. Omitted when the conflict is not version-based.

oneOf.description:
Structured detail, shaped by `error` (see [`ErrorDetails`]): every
field-level failure on a `validation_error` response when the raiser
has a field list, so a form can render them all at once; every firing
rule on a `rule_violation` response from a business rule; every
refused field on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required`. Omitted
otherwise.

error.description:
Stable machine-readable code — `not_found`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`,
`attribute_not_writable`, `limit_exceeded`,
`conflict`, `version_conflict`, `duplicate_detected`, `idempotency_conflict`,
`validation_error`, `customer_tests_failed`, `feature_unavailable`, `feature_hidden`,
`rate_limit_exceeded`, `overloaded`, `capability_unavailable`,
`metadata_authoring_locked`, `transition_not_allowed`,
`rule_violation`, `field_locked`, `field_locked_required`,
`reauth_required`, `server_timeout`, `query_timeout`, `read_only`, `payload_too_large`,
`request_rejected`, `invalid_cursor`, `resync_needed`, `cascade_restricted`,
`idempotency_outcome_unknown`, `idempotency_replay_unavailable`,
`method_not_allowed`, or
`internal_error` — one per `AppError` variant (`FieldLocked` answers
two: plain and required) (`attome-types/src/error.rs`); M01 Core C-23
found this list four codes short of the taxonomy it documents.

errors.description:
Every field-level failure on a `validation_error`, as
`{attribute, rule, message, fix}`.

field.description:
Present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` (D-789): the first
refused field (every one is in `details.fields`); on
`attribute_not_writable` (Q15-T4): the attribute the caller may not
write.

hidden.description:
Present on `duplicate_detected`: how many more matches the caller may
not read.

instance.description: The request path the problem happened at.

matches.description:
Present on `duplicate_detected` (A15-T4): the existing records the
save matches that the caller may read (record, rule, score).

request_id.description:
Present on responses that passed through the request-id middleware
(D-043); absent on the few pre-middleware rejection paths.

retry_after_sec.description:
Present on a `rate_limit_exceeded` response when the limiter knows its
window: seconds to wait before retrying, equal by construction to the
`Retry-After` header on the same response (BTY-11a). Omitted when the
limit that was hit has no known window.

retryable.description:
Whether the same request may succeed later (the error catalogue's
verdict for `code`).

rule_id.description:
Present on a `rule_violation` response (D-472): the id of the
`xrm_core_rule` whose failing expression produced this 422, so a
client can highlight or re-check the exact rule without parsing
`message`. Omitted on every other code, and on any response that
does not name a rule.
Also present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` (D-789): the
business rule that locks `field`.

rule_name.description:
Present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required`: the display name
of the rule that locks `field`.

title.description:
A short title for `code` in the request's language (Z14-T3), e.g.
`The resource was not found.`

type.description: Z14-T1 (RFC 9457): `about:blank`; the problem is named by `code`.

FieldError.description:
One field-level failure inside `ErrorResponse.details` (BTY-16b): the
field the caller sent, a stable machine-readable `code` the client maps
to localized text (e.g. `required`, `too_long`, `invalid_format`,
`not_allowed`), and the English server-side `message`.

A list, not a single error, so one 422 can answer with every bad field at
once (BTY-F11) instead of making a form discover them one round-trip at a
time.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable failure code for this field, independent of
the message text.

field.description:
The offending field, as the caller addressed it (e.g. `email` or
`amount`).

message.description: Human-readable, English, server-side detail for this field.

FieldLockedDetails.description:
`details` of a `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` response: every
refused field, the first being the one the top-level `field` names.

expires_in_days.description:
How long the link works, 1 to 90 days (30 by default); never past the
quote's own expiry.

LeadConvertBody.description: A conversion's choices; every target defaults to `create`.

account_matches.description: Existing accounts the new one would repeat, that the caller may read.

hidden_matches.description: Matches the caller may not read.

moved.description: Activities and notes moved off the lead.

LockedField.description:
One field a business rule locks for the writer (D-789 §3.5): `effect` is
`hidden` or `disabled`. No value is ever echoed.

ManagedBooking.description: A booking as its manage link shows it.

ManagerLine.description: The two kinds of reporting line.

from_territory.description: The rule-made territory it leaves, if any.

to_territory.description: The territory it joins, if any rule now matches.

invoice_request_id.description:
The billing invoice request it handed off; `None` when the order's
`billing_rule` is `on_shipment` or `on_delivery` (F6-T13: fulfilment
asks billing per shipment line instead).

OrderMade.description: An order made, or the one already made from the same source.

created.description: False when the source had already been ordered.

companies.description: The companies the chart covers (one unless it is a group chart).

next_cursor.description: More contacts follow: pass this as `cursor`.

unplaced.description: Readable contacts whose manager is missing or not readable.

account_id.description: The company the person works at (several in a group chart).

collapsed_children.description: When the branch is collapsed: how many people report to this one.

PaginatedResponse_SalesBattlecard.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

battlecard_ref.description: The knowledge article holding the battle card, when one is set.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_SalesOpportunityLine.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_SalesPlay.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: A playbook that applies to the deal.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_SalesProductPrice.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PublicBookingPage.description: A booking page as the public sees it.

location.description: Where an in-person meeting is, or the number a phone meeting uses.

meeting_type.description: D20-T3: `video`, `phone` or `in_person`; none when the page does not say.

video_provider.description: The video service of a video meeting.

name.description: The person deciding, as they sign.

QuoteLineView.description: One line as the customer sees it.

unset.description: The deal's quotes that stopped being primary.

row_version.description: The quote's row version after the call.

status.description: `sent`, or `pending_approval` when it waits for the approval process.

QuoteTotals.description: The quote's totals from its lines and its own discount percent. Pure.

QuoteView.description: A quote as the customer sees it.

truncated.description: More accounts exist than a preview looks at.

RuleFailure.description:
One business-rule `error` policy that fired (D-789 §3.3), inside a
`rule_violation` body's `details.rules`. Carries names and the rule's own
message, never a record value.

field.description: The field the policy is attached to, when it names one.

rule_name.description: The rule's display name (its name when it has none).

RuleViolationDetails.description:
`details` of a `rule_violation` response (D-789): the field of the first
failing policy, when it names one, and every blocking `error` policy that
fired, the first (by rule display order) being the one `rule_id` names.

records.description: For a `manual` list: the records to add.

sent.description: The contacts a survey went to.

script_answers.description: The script's answers, as JSON text.

reason.description: Why the member is passed over (shown on the list).

move_splits.description: Move the old owner's splits to the new owner (else they stay).

old_owner_role.description:
Keep the old owner on the team with this team role; absent removes
them and their share.

needs_new_manager.description: The contacts who reported to this one and need a new manager.

new_contact_id.description: The new contact at the next account.

new_account_id.description: The account the person joined, if known.

roles.description: The account team roles to copy, e.g. `["account_manager", "pre_sales"]`.

SalesCpqProblem.description: One failure, for a person or an agent to act on.

percent.description: Decimal text, 0 to 100; null removes it.

opportunity_ids.description: The caller's open deals that miss at least one default member.

SalesFeedbackSkip.description: A contact the request did not reach, and why.

snapshot_id.description:
D6-T8: for a deal discount, the snapshot that undoes it
(`POST /api/v1/sales/undo/{snapshot_id}`, 30 minutes).

previous_manager_id.description: The manager before this change: set it back to undo.

opportunity_competitor_id.description: The deal's competitor link, on a confirm.

previous_manager_id.description: The contact's manager before an accepted draft set it (to undo).

SalesOrgChartDraftDecision.description: Accept or reject an org chart draft.

accept.description:
`true` sets the proposed manager (and department); `false` only
marks the draft rejected.

render_id.description: The docgen render; read it at `GET /api/v1/docgen/renders/{render_id}`.

SalesOrgChartExportBody.description: What to export an org chart as.

format.description: `pdf`; the document renderer makes PDFs only.

locale.description: `en` or `ar`; the template shows both languages.

rows_shifted.description: Rows moved now; zero when a job moves them.

manager_id.description: The new manager, or `null` to clear the line.

change_reason.description: Required when the deal is won.

SalesSplitsOutcome.description:
The splits after the change, or the approval a won deal's change waits
on.

force.description: Overwrite even when both sides changed.

deal_lines.description: Both line sets, when both changed.

snapshot_id.description: D6-T8: the snapshot that undoes the sync (30 minutes).

skipped.description: Members left out because their own roles do not allow the access.

partner_contact_ref.description: A partner contact on the team.

user_ref.description: A user on the team; give this or `partner_contact_ref`.

SkipReason.description: Why a member was passed over.

SkippedMember.description: A member passed over on the way, with its reason.

Slot.description: A time that can be booked.

SplitInput.description: One split as a caller gives it.

line_id.description: For a split of one line rather than the whole deal.

reason.description: Why the discount is needed, shown to the approvers.

SyncLine.description: One line as the hash sees it.

TeamAccess.description: The access a member gets to the deal.

VoicemailRequest.description: A voicemail to drop into a call.

Warning.description:
Something the server did that the caller should know about though the
request succeeded (a value truncated, a default applied, a page clamped):
a stable `code` and English `message`. Sent only when there is one.

portal_session.name: __Secure-wp_{portal}_session
portal_session.description: A web portal user's session cookie, issued by the portal's sign-in; `{portal}` is the portal's keyword (`wp_{portal}_session` on plain-http local dev). Valid only on that portal's own routes.

s2s_hmac.name: x-s2s-signature
s2s_hmac.description: A system-to-system call, signed. Send `x-s2s-client-id`, `x-s2s-key-id`, `x-s2s-timestamp` (Unix milliseconds, within 300 seconds of the server's clock), `x-s2s-nonce` (single use: a repeat is refused) and `x-s2s-signature`: the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed by the hex-decoded client secret, of `METHOD`, `PATH_AND_QUERY`, the hex SHA-256 of the body, `TIMESTAMP` and `NONCE`, joined by newlines in that order.

session_cookie.name: __Host-session_token
session_cookie.description: Browser session cookie issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login. Mutating requests additionally require the CSRF conditions enforced by `middleware::csrf`.
